scope: Linux focused recovered-baseline dirty-state fix; no full matrix, Windows, visual claim, release or milestone closure.
root_cause: Recovery LoadText resets saved undo length to 0, SetDirty(true) previously did not invalidate it. First edit + Undo returned unsaved recovery text with Changed false.
fix: SetDirty(true) sets saved undo length -1, false aligns current history. Normal SaveFile and LoadText still establish clean baselines.
impact: Confirmed lost dirty flag and skipped unsaved-review/SaveAll eligibility. Idle does not delete journal because it calls UpdateJournal only for dirty buffers. Earlier possible journal-deletion impact is retracted.
